profiles.name: baseline
profiles.description: Day 3 behaviour: every optimization switch off.

profiles.name: optimized
profiles.description: Rule routing (no tool-selection call on plain lookups; calculator nudge), query-embedding and tool-result caches. Query rewrite stays on: turning it off was measured and rejected (see optimized-no-rewrite).

profiles.name: optimized-small
profiles.description: optimized + first answer draft of simple lookups on qwen3:1.7b (verification and revisions stay on qwen3:8b).

profiles.name: optimized-no-rewrite
profiles.description: Rejected variant: optimized without the small-model query-rewrite call. multi_document 4/5 -> 2/5 and tokens -32% vs baseline: the raw question ('RPO') does not retrieve the 'Availability and Recovery' chunks; the rewrite expands it. (Measured with the earlier routing that also skipped comparisons, so its multi-availability failure is partly that bug.)

profiles.name: vector-only
profiles.description: Retrieval probe: vector search only (no keyword side, no RRF).

profiles.name: keyword-only
profiles.description: Retrieval probe: Postgres full-text search only.

profiles.name: degraded-chunking
profiles.description: Regression demo: fixed 250-char chunks with no overlap, vector-only retrieval.
